reviews.text: I bought a light-up collar for my dog ​​here, and I’m using it very well in Korea. My dog ​​is a Labrador Retriever, and it’s convenient because the neck circumference is adjustable and it’s rechargeable. It’s a trendy item that I’ve been using without any breakdowns so far! They also sell a lot of good treats, and it was a store where I wanted to buy many things. I think it would be great for dog owners to visit and check it out.

GREEN DOG & CAT Daikanyama was a wonderful shop for pet lovers, offering a wide range of products and services for dogs and cats. The store was bright and clean, and the carefully selected food, treats, and care products were a joy to browse.

The staff were knowledgeable and helpful, providing excellent advice tailored to each pet's health and lifestyle. It's the perfect shop for anyone who wants to choose truly high-quality products for their beloved dog or cat.

Located in the lush greenery of Daikanyama T-SITE, it's also a great place to stop by during a walk. The shop offers products and services that enrich the time spent with pets, creating a comfortable space for pet owners.

🐶🐱🌿 It's a warm and welcoming shop that reflects the love for dogs and cats, offering many new discoveries and making it a wonderful place to visit again. ✨

When I go to Daikanyama with my dog, I often drop by this shop.

The interior decor is constantly being changed, so it never gets boring.

It's always bustling with other dogs and customers!
The sukiyaki was delicious. The meat was tender and I was very satisfied.

The customer before me was paying for a special order item at the register, and the staff seemed flustered. I waited about 10 minutes to pay, but there was no apology whatsoever, not even a "sorry for the wait."

I've never had a bad experience at this store before, so this really bothered me.

The store clerk's attitude was terrible when I asked about the availability of an item.

Furthermore, due to that clerk's mistake, I was overcharged. While I was there waiting for another clerk to correct the transaction, the clerk completely ignored me.

Mistakes happen, but can't they even apologize?

Please train your staff.
I liked that the facility has a parking lot, making it easy to get to. The atmosphere inside the store is also very nice.

What a great pet shop.
Small, compact - with a full range of anything you can imagine.

My cat has been under their care for over two years.

They are very conscientious, and I feel completely at ease entrusting my cat's health and medication needs to them.

I'm always grateful.

I stopped by while traveling, and there was a dog grooming shop there, so I got to see a lot of cute dogs. However, the clothes were a bit expensive (over 5,000 yen~), so I only bought salmon stick snacks. ^^ The staff were friendly, and I enjoyed looking at the items inside.

Dear H.S. (haru), Thank you very much for visiting GREEN DOG Daikanyama. We are so happy that your dog enjoyed the tasting. Please come visit us again with your dog. All of our staff look forward to seeing you.

This shop has a wide selection of high-quality natural foods and snacks. 
Many of the staff are knowledgeable about food and will be happy to give you any advice you may have.
I came to the store to buy toys, but the selection is just so-so. It's better to buy them in Korea.
